● The Game — Explore & Collect

Straight from the TwoRLabs shield — the blocky brothers

Explore.
Collect. Fill the bag.

Start in the lobby, walk the game pads, then head out into the park world. Treasures are scattered and hidden everywhere — potions, wrenches, gems, stars and more. Walk up to one and press COLLECT to drop it in your inventory bag. How full can you fill it?

Building the world…0%
How it works: Lobby first — walk to a glowing pad and press Play to open that zone of the world. Every zone hides different treasures for your bag.

Works on phone, tablet & computer — same world, any screen size. Touch joystick, tap-to-walk, or keyboard.

⏳ While you wait — Orb Pop

Mini-games live in the loading room so waiting is never boring. Pop as many orbs as you can before the world opens.

Explorer goal — collect 10 treasures
YOU

Explore the park

Walk with W A S D, the arrows, the joystick, or tap where you want to go. Treasures sparkle all over — walk up to one until it lights up, then press COLLECT (or the E key).

Every treasure you grab lands in your bag. Tap the Bag button any time to see everything you've found. New treasures appear as you explore — keep walking!
